headline: Apple Urges Customers with Screen Issues on iPhone Duo to Seek Replacements
summary: Apple has acknowledged display issues on certain newly released iPhone Duo handsets, urging affected users to contact customer support for device replacements.
why: Hardware defects in newly released flagship Apple devices can drive warranty servicing costs and pressure short-term consumer electronics revenue.

impacts.name: Apple Inc
impacts.why: Device replacement programs and hardware screen defects generate unexpected customer support and warranty costs.
